In twenty eleven, a man in Brazil found a penguin covered in oil.
He cleaned him, fed him sardines, and set him free.
He stayed eleven months. Then he left.
In June, he was back. And the next year. And the next.
Nobody else is allowed to touch him. He pecks them.
Everyone needs someone who comes back.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny is always there.
